cross_root_duplicate_indicators.method: Candidate files were matched by case-normalized filename and byte size, then full SHA-256 hashed within fixed budgets.
cross_root_duplicate_indicators.interpretation: Indicators only. Nested/split roots may intentionally contain the same files; no files were changed.

nifti_volume_segmentation_pairing.check: NIfTI filename-index pairing across volume_pt1..volume_pt5 and segmentations

bounded_geometry_probe.interpretation: Different qform/sform codes can change which transform a loader selects even when sampled numeric transforms match; normalize only after source-specific review.

nifti_volume_segmentation_pairing.semantics: Filename-index evidence only; volume/mask geometry, anatomy, provenance, and label meaning were not validated.

named_core_evaluation_dataset_presence.interpretation: Reconciled on 2026-10-25 against the supplementary archive inventory and task registry. Presence does not establish permission, training eligibility, clinical validity, or current model availability: MURA remains permission-blocked and PTB-XL remains research-only.
